newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunker fuel steady, quiet.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunker fuel steady, quiet.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were steady in quiet trade on Thursday, with volume totalling 25,000 to 30,000 tonnes, dealers said.
"Trade is very average and we are covering current avails," one dealer said.
Rotterdam 380 cst was priced at about $85 a tonne, with 180 cst at $90. Antwerp prices were about $1 above Rotterdam.
The Mediterranean was also flat, with an easier tone, dealers said.
"There's not much demand and prices are trying to ease. It's generally quiet but there have been one or two enquiries," said one.
Fos 380 cst was priced at about $89 with 180 cst at $97, with Piraeus at about the same level and Augusta $1-2 higher.
